programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The new series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story may have landed the number one spot on Netflix, but it wasn’t popular with everyone. Angry family members of Dahmer’s victims say the controversial drama re-traumatized them and romanticized the notorious serial killer. You’ve seen Hollywood’s version. Today, Dr. Phil is telling the real story and meeting the real people who say they knew the real monster that was Jeffrey Dahmer. In an exclusive interview, hear from the sister of one victim who says the series glorified the man she calls “Satan,” as well as two men who say they were tortured and terrorized by Dahmer and survived.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Victims and survivors of Jeffrey Dahmer say they want people to see him for who he really was -- not the glamorized TV version. See a never-before-aired interview with Dahmer’s father and stepmother that sheds light on the monster behind the man. They provide chilling details about his bizarre childhood behaviors. Plus, the Netflix series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story pushed a decades-old story into today’s spotlight, some say giving it a 2022 “pop culture moment.” After the series debuted, Dahmer’s infamous glasses went up for sale for $150,000, and people dressed up as the notorious serial killer for Halloween. Has our culture’s obsession with true crime desensitized us?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine your mother so high on prescription drugs that she falls face first into her food, or your husband on a 15-day drug binge that ends with him passing out in front of your young children. For Dr. Phil's guests, these scenarios are their grim reality.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jason and Brandy have been married less than a year, but they say the honeymoon is definitely over! His lying and flirting with other women has her addicted to snooping on him. Will they make it to their first anniversary or should they call it quits? Then, they've only been married for eight months, but Michael says his wife's violent temper is making his life a living hell. Dr. Phil shows them how to fight fair. Plus, a guest who's terrified of getting divorced … and he's not even married yet! Will he ever be ready to pop the question to his girlfriend?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Her parents and several therapists have failed to help her erase her distorted body image. This 19-year-old battles both anorexia and bulimia. With the help of her parents, fiancé, and brother, Dr. Phil discusses the steps to recovery. Plus, meet another young woman who lives alone with her disease and her sense of complete failure. Dr. Phil explains early detection, the warning signs, and treatment.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Chandra and her siblings, Charity, Perry and Preston, say their mother, Pamela’s, hoarding is so out of control that nearly every inch of her 9,000-square-foot home is filled with “junk.” The siblings say that growing up, Pamela would pick through their garbage to save items, which forced them to sneak trash out of the house. They say as they got older, her hoarding became progressively worse, prompting them to stage an intervention in 2012, which escalated to the point of police being called. Pamela says she feels her family unfairly “ganged up” on her and insists she’s not a hoarder -- so, how does she explain the mess? Plus, Pamela’s husband, Richard, moved out of the house two years ago -- he says because of the hoarding, but she says otherwise. Hear why Pamela claims Richard is equally to blame for the family’s problems. Can Dr. Phil help Pamela get rid of her clutter -- and help this family get back on track?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Anything goes on “Ask Dr. Phil"! A 25-year-old claims she won’t find happiness until she becomes a millionaire…and would even ditch her loved ones to get it! Is her search for wealth unreasonable? Then, meet one empty nester who cries everyday about her daughter leaving for college—and it’s been four years! Also, you’ll be surprised to find out why one woman wouldn’t pick up the phone, even if her life depended on it!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when an unhealthy teen relationship threatens to tear a mother and daughter apart? Giesel says her 18-year-old daughter, Devynn, is obsessed with her boyfriend and is damaging a once promising future. Watch the drama unfold as a pregnancy scare rocks this teen's life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nina says even after she lowered her 15-year-old daughter, Nicolette’s, monthly allowance from $5,000 to $1,000, Nicolette is still overspending on her credit cards in order to keep up with teens in their hometown of Beverly Hills. Nina says she recently allowed a family friend, Joel, to move into her home so he could help chauffeur Nicolette around and watch her spending. Nicolette admits to spending her day having lunch in Beverly Hills, shopping, and making YouTube videos. Nina and Joel say they worry about Nicolette, who admits to having zero future goals except to not work, be rich, wear designer clothes and drive a Mercedes G-Wagen. Dr. Phil surprises Nicolette, her mother, and Joel by sending Nicolette on a special assignment near Skid Row in downtown Los Angeles a few days prior to taping Dr. Phil.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues to speak with parents, Liz and Jim, about why each blames the other for their son’s drug addiction. Liz says she blames what she calls Jim’s abusive parenting philosophy for their son retreating to drugs, which Jim vehemently denies. Find out what happens when Jim faces his daughter, Chloe, and son, Nic. Will they support their mother’s accusations against their father?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil’s guests say they’re devastated by a childhood trauma, and they want to confront the parent who they say caused it. First, Mandy says she hates her mother, Becky, for abducting her when she was a child, changing her name and keeping her in hiding for two years over allegations of abuse. Becky says she doesn’t regret going on the run with her daughter, and she’d do it again. The pair has only seen each other once in the past 22 years. Is it too late to start over? Then, Butch says his father, Ulysses, stole his childhood. He confronts his father for the first time in 33 years to find out why he killed his mother. Butch was just 12 years old and says he remembers every moment of that day, including being used to get his mother to come back into the house after his parents’ fight. Ulysses says the "unfortunate incident" was an accident, and he wants to make things right with his son before he dies. Will Butch get the answers he’s searching for and accept his father’s apology?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, amid claims of drinking and doing drugs with teenagers and extramarital affairs, Dr. Phil revealed that Lauren’s father, John, had been dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news, for stealing thousands of dollars’ worth of breast pumps and selling them online --and admitted to taking Lauren on some of his shoplifting heists. Today, John admits that he’s addicted to Xanax and crack cocaine, and to stealing from Lauren’s mother to support his habit. Lauren says she wants her mom to kick him out of their lives once and for all. How does Laura respond? It’s a shocking conclusion you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: All couples argue, but Dr. Phil says name-calling, temper tantrums and hitting below the belt can ruin a marriage. He sits down with Mark and Leana who have been married for only five months but say they’re headed for divorce court. Leana says her husband spends more time with his band mates than he does with her and their four children. Mark says Leana constantly emasculates him, and he accuses her of being unfaithful. You won’t believe what home video cameras captured during the newlyweds' 62-minute fight. Find out what Dr. Phil witnesses that disturbs him the most. Can this couple resolve their differences, or should they call it quits? If you and your mate are having knock-down, drag-out battles, don’t miss Dr. Phil’s rules for fighting fair!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is it possible to be in love with two men at the same time? Orlena is desperate for help. She says she still has feelings for her ex-husband, Chad, and she adores her current husband, Brent. Chad is a soldier and when duty called, he fought in Iraq. He returned home a changed man and their love shattered forever. What changed Chad, and what caused Orlena to leave him? Devastated and heartbroken, Orlena moved on and into the arms of Brent. Two months after marrying Brent, Chad called and begged Orlena to come back. Find out Brent's strong message for Chad. Since Chad made initial contact with Orlena, they have talked numerous times, and he even spent three days visiting her. What has she been saying to Chad, and are the chats appropriate for a married woman to have? And, will Orlena honor her commitment to Brent or return to the man who broke her heart? Don't miss this heart-wrenching story of a woman torn between two wonderful men.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Chandra and her siblings, Charity, Perry and Preston, say their mother, Pamela’s, hoarding is so out of control that nearly every inch of her 9,000-square-foot home is filled with “junk.” The siblings say that growing up, Pamela would pick through their garbage to save items, which forced them to sneak trash out of the house. They say as they got older, her hoarding became progressively worse, prompting them to stage an intervention in 2012, which escalated to the point of police being called. Pamela says she feels her family unfairly “ganged up” on her and insists she’s not a hoarder -- so, how does she explain the mess? Plus, Pamela’s husband, Richard, moved out of the house two years ago -- he says because of the hoarding, but she says otherwise. Hear why Pamela claims Richard is equally to blame for the family’s problems. Can Dr. Phil help Pamela get rid of her clutter -- and help this family get back on track?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Criminals, deadbeats and bad boys -- most women run from these types of men, but some women say Mr. Wrong is the right guy for them. Kelly says her daughter, Heather, married Mr. Wrong, and the price she paid was losing her children. Kelly says Heather's husband, Earl, is an unfit father and can't provide for the family. Heather, 25, says she stands by her 41-year-old husband, and wants her parents to stop sabotaging her marriage. Are Heather and Earl really unfit parents, or does Earl deserve a second chance? Then, Sarah, 29, says she's been married to three men in prison, and her current husband is serving a life sentence for murder. Even more shocking, she often takes her two young daughters to visit their stepdad behind bars, and she says they love to see him. Why is Sarah drawn to these types of men? Sarah's mom weighs in on her daughter's love life. And, a woman who gave up nearly 20 years of her life for a man in jail has an important message for Sarah. Will Sarah feel differently after meeting Darlene?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Christina, who emailed him desperate for help for her daughter, Tara, who she says can be an angry monster. Christina left the home when Tara was 13 years old, but now, she says she's worried that her daughter is in a toxic situation with the ex-husband she calls narcissistic and his 22-year-old new wife who is 20 weeks pregnant. Today, meet the new wife and find out if Dr. Phil can help this chaotic triangle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: This Dr. Phil Family is angry, out of control, and about to get an intervention in The Dr. Phil House. Melissa, 22, wrote to Dr. Phil for help for her self-destructive family. Her mother, Myra, and her stepfather, Gene, have a long history of betrayals, infidelity, anger and years of bitter resentment. Melissa says her family even turns special occasions into volatile disasters with turkey dinners and Christmas trees being thrown across the room. The fighting got so bad, Melissa says she had to move away from her extreme family. Her brothers, Edwin, 20, and Eugene, 17, attest that their home is a war zone, and that they have witnessed fights between their parents that involve name-calling, spitting and dousing each other with water, all in front of their 7-year-old brother. Myra says she can’t forgive Gene for his four affairs, but especially the last one, which was with a 19-year-old. Over three years have passed since Gene’s last affair, but Myra still calls him a pedophile every chance she gets, and says she’d leave if it weren’t for their youngest child. Can this family learn to stop the drama, heal their anger and start over with a healthy foundation, or should they call it quits for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When it comes to families, conflict is nearly inevitable, but when you add the stress of a mental illness, it can divide even the closest knit household. Coni’s 18-year-old daughter, Katherine, was diagnosed with bipolar disorder at 12. Since then, her daughter’s behavior has been violent and erratic, and Coni says the chaos is tearing their family apart. Coni’s husband has threatened divorce, her oldest son has moved out, and her youngest daughter says her childhood was awful because of her older sister. The family thinks Katherine should be moved to a facility that can better serve her, but Coni says that is not an option. Learn what Dr. Phil says this family is doing wrong and how they can create a happy, peaceful household.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Many little girls dream of the perfect wedding day with a fairytale gown, beautiful flowers and their handsome groom, but Dr. Phil's guests say their wedding bells hit a sour note. Amy says the day she and Steve tied the knot turned into a disaster. The sun scorched the guests, then there was a downpour, the wedding arch fell and hit the pastor, and the cake crumbled as they were cutting it. She says it was a huge dream shattered, and she can't move past it. Steve says he had a blast, and Amy needs to lighten up. What does Dr. Phil think? Then, shortly after Mandy and her husband, Kris, said "I do," a three-story deck collapsed and they and 30 of their family and friends were seriously injured. Mandy says she left her wedding strapped to a stretcher, and she and Kris spent their wedding night in the emergency room. Although this took place over two years ago, the couple thinks about it every day. How can they overcome their guilt? And, Kurt and Brandi recently renewed their vows because they say they wanted a fresh start to their seven-year marriage. Just months after their ceremony, Kurt filed for divorce when he found out a secret Brandi had been keeping. Will the results of polygraph tests inspire this couple to make their marriage work or end it for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mom wants to be a better parent. A wife can’t get her husband off the couch. A husband that just can’t seem to please his finicky wife. What do all these people have in common? Dr. Phil gives them what they need to put their lives back on track in the “How To…” episode. No matter what the issue or situation, we all share problems that keep us from leader a happier, healthier life. Tune in and find yourself in our courageous guests as they face their own battles with the help of Dr. Phil McGraw. Appointment television you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Stay-at-home mom Jessica claims her soon-to-be ex-husband of 23 years, Mike, is a narcissist who controls everything in her and their teenage daughters’ lives, especially the finances. Sixteen-year-old Chloe and 18-year-old Zoey say the worst thing he did was to shatter their dreams of becoming professional dancers in New York City. But Mike claims Jessica is putting the girls in the middle of their fight and brainwashing them to hate him. Dr. Phil tells Mike and Jessica what every couple needs to do with children when their marriage falls apart.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Four engaged couples wondering if they're ready to walk down the aisle move into The Dr. Phil House. Each couple will be put to the test to see if they really know their partner's flaws, funds, family and future expectations. After several challenges, will the couples decide to head to the altar or just call it quits? Lacey says her fiancé, Kalin, has pushed, choked and cheated on her, all while she was pregnant with their child. Kalin says he knows he had an anger problem, but claims he hasn't cheated since their baby was born. Steve is afraid of displeasing his fiancée, Stephanie, who wants to be treated like a princess. He says nothing he does is right, and anything can set off her temper. Stephanie wants more attention from Steve but is unsure if their wedding will happen because of the fighting. Scott thinks his wife-to-be, Lisa, tears down his dreams of being a musician, while Lisa thinks Scott is a male chauvinist with immature and unrealistic dreams. Tim and Lilly are just 19 years old and aren't sure they're prepared for their baby, due in two months. They want to get married but can't afford a ring or a wedding. Part 1 summary: After moving into The Dr. Phil House, Kalin gets his first assignment. Since Lacey says Kalin hasn't helped with their daughter since she was born 11 months ago, he has to care for a computerized baby that will record how well he meets its needs. The couples' first challenge is a game called Hitched or Ditched, where the couples have to guess how their partners will answer certain questions. Lisa and Scott win the game, but others question whether Scott cheated.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What creates a monster? As the popular new Netflix series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story pushes the heinous crimes of the notorious serial killer back into the spotlight, what can we learn about what may have made him the evil he was? Do chilling home videos of Jeffrey Dahmer as a little boy show an innocent child before he became evil? Or, were the signs already there? His parents reveal the red flags they say they missed.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dennis Quaid joins Dr. Phil to discuss his new movie, “Yours, Mine and Ours". In this family comedy, single parents Frank (Dennis Quaid) and Helen (Rene Russo) plan to tie the knot… but with 18 children between them trying to sabotage the marriage, they discover that weddings – and families – can’t be built in a day. Then, meet a real-life blended family whose battles are tearing them apart. Arguments over space, chores, and discipline make it feel like a war zone for two families trying to blend under one roof. Dr. Phil gives advice to this Brady Bunch gone wild!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In this powerful program, Dr. Phil exposes the frightening yet underreported problem of mothers on the verge on committing child abuse. We meet ordinary women who live in fear that they’re going to hurt their children in a fit of uncontrollable rage. Chrystel says she feels rage and snaps and then it gets to the point where there's no return. Jessica says her fits of rage become so intense, she's scared that she will hurt her son. Answering their desperate pleas for help, Dr. Phil explains how to identify cues leading up to this precarious state, and tells moms what to do when they start to lose control.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mike thought his wife, Bridgette's, excessive shopping was destroying their marriage. What started as a shopping intervention turned into an intervention with a family in crisis.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It was the picture-perfect wedding: a model marrying the handsome man she says treated her like gold. But after a few years of marriage, Kevin and Heather are in a dangerous relationship filled with verbal abuse and violence. Should these two work on saving their marriage or get out before someone gets killed?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Unemployed, unmotivated and under your roof - they're family freeloaders and they're hurting the ones they love the most. Dr. Phil has advice for a 28-year-old who still lives at home and a 20-year-old who is happy to live in his older sister's house but refuses to do any of the chores necessary to maintain it. Also, Dr. Phil finds out why a daughter thinks her mother is a gold digger.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Have you ever felt like you had to walk on eggshells around someone, constantly worrying about how they would react to anything you said or did? What if you were married to that person?

In an exclusive interview, hear from the sister of one victim who says the series glorified the man she calls “Satan,” as well as two men who say they were tortured and terrorized by Dahmer and survived.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Victims and survivors of Jeffrey Dahmer say they want people to see him for who he really was -- not the glamorized TV version. See a never-before-aired interview with Dahmer’s father and stepmother that sheds light on the monster behind the man. They provide chilling details about his bizarre childhood behaviors. Plus, the Netflix series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story pushed a decades-old story into today’s spotlight, some say giving it a 2022 “pop culture moment.” After the series debuted, Dahmer’s infamous glasses went up for sale for $150,000, and people dressed up as the notorious serial killer for Halloween. Has our culture’s obsession with true crime desensitized us?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What creates a monster? As the popular new Netflix series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story pushes the heinous crimes of the notorious serial killer back into the spotlight, what can we learn about what may have made him the evil he was? Do chilling home videos of Jeffrey Dahmer as a little boy show an innocent child before he became evil? Or, were the signs already there? His parents reveal the red flags they say they missed.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In 1985, Rachel’s 14-year-old sister, Lori, was found murdered, and Rachel is desperate to prove her claim that Lori’s ex-boyfriend, Walt, killed the teen and got away with it -- an accusation he vehemently denies. Walt was initially tried for the murder, but the case was dismissed after the trial resulted in a hung jury -- and he says Rachel needs to stop pointing the finger at him and move on. Tensions run high when Rachel confronts Walt on Dr. Phil’s stage. Where was Walt the night of Lori’s death? And, how does he explain allegations that he has made inconsistent statements to police? Then, Walt says he passed a polygraph in 1985, clearing his name. Dr. Phil calls on polygraph expert Jack Trimarco to examine the results -- what are his thoughts? Plus, don’t miss Part 2, when Walt takes a new polygraph test -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A concerned daughter seeks Dr. Phil’s help to rescue her mother from a deceptive online relationship.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A concerned daughter seeks Dr. Phil’s help to rescue her mother from a deceptive online relationship.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: This Dr. Phil Family is angry, out of control, and about to get an intervention in The Dr. Phil House. Melissa, 22, wrote to Dr. Phil for help for her self-destructive family. Her mother, Myra, and her stepfather, Gene, have a long history of betrayals, infidelity, anger and years of bitter resentment. Melissa says her family even turns special occasions into volatile disasters with turkey dinners and Christmas trees being thrown across the room. The fighting got so bad, Melissa says she had to move away from her extreme family. Her brothers, Edwin, 20, and Eugene, 17, attest that their home is a war zone, and that they have witnessed fights between their parents that involve name-calling, spitting and dousing each other with water, all in front of their 7-year-old brother. Myra says she can’t forgive Gene for his four affairs, but especially the last one, which was with a 19-year-old. Over three years have passed since Gene’s last affair, but Myra still calls him a pedophile every chance she gets, and says she’d leave if it weren’t for their youngest child. Can this family learn to stop the drama, heal their anger and start over with a healthy foundation, or should they call it quits for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bridget says she is worried that her 38-year-old brother-in-law Kevin may be having an inappropriate relationship with her 16-year-old daughter, Grace. Bridget says red flags went up when Grace told her that Kevin put whipped cream on his neck and asked her to lick it off, and then found a letter from Kevin hidden in Grace’s bedroom. Kevin strongly denies having an inappropriate relationship with Grace, and claims he’s just trying to be a father figure since Grace’s dad passed away. But is there something more?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bridget says she’s not sure what to believe about the relationship between her 38-year-old brother-in-law, Kevin, and 16-year-old daughter, Grace.Dr. Phil says Bridget is a parent in denial and in need of a wake-up call. He sits down one-on-one with Kevin. How does Kevin explain his actions?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents Liz and Jim say their 16-year-old son, Nic, has a serious drug problem that has such a hold on him, they claim he even stole $75,000 in gold from his parents’ safe and spent it all on drugs! But, Liz says she is convinced that her husband is to blame. Liz accuses Jim of being a narcissist and misogynist, whose parenting philosophy is based on intimidation and abuse, and claims that is what drove their son to drugs. Jim denies Liz’s allegations, claiming she has gone to great lengths to paint him as a villain. He says she is the major problem, and calls her the world's lousiest parent and a doormat who helped enable Nic's deadly addictions.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues to speak with parents, Liz and Jim, about why each blames the other for their son’s drug addiction. Liz says she blames what she calls Jim’s abusive parenting philosophy for their son retreating to drugs, which Jim vehemently denies. Find out what happens when Jim faces his daughter, Chloe, and son, Nic. Will they support their mother’s accusations against their father?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Autumn claims her ex-boyfriend, D’Andre, abused her, which he denies. Why does she defend him to her parents?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation continues with D’Andre, who blames his abusive relationship with his ex-girlfriend, Autumn, on her upbringing.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: April says another woman is electronically stealing photos of her children and posing as their mother online.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with husband and wife, Nathan and April, who claim a woman named Ashley is fixated on their beautiful twin daughters.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his work with The Dr. Phil Family, an out-of-control, angry group with a long history of infidelities, betrayals and bitter resentments. Melissa’s boyfriend, Randy, joins the family at The Dr. Phil House, but Gene and Myra are not happy to see him. They think that Randy is a liar and a thief, and the reason Melissa has gained about 100 pounds in the last five years. Gene and Myra attempt to talk to Melissa about her weight, but Melissa is anything but receptive. Then, because they often blame each other for the chaos in the family, Melissa and Gene are assigned to bury the hatchet long enough to cook a family dinner together, without help from anyone else. Will these relatives be able to follow the rules? After dinner, a family meeting turns heated with accusations and tearful confessions. Dr. Phil joins the family and confronts Melissa and Randy about their sometimes violent relationship and Melissa’s mismanagement of her health. Can this couple create a nurturing relationship for the sake of their autistic child? Will Melissa do what it takes to gain control over her weight?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After all their hard work, the latest Dr. Phil Family receives some surprises from Dr. Phil! He informs Melissa that everything she needs to get her life back on track is headed her way: a complete health evaluation, personal trainer, nutritionist, and food service delivered to her door. In addition, she’ll receive help for her depression and be connected with a developmental disabilities specialist for her autistic son. But it all comes with a condition: Melissa and Randy need to heal their toxic relationship. Then, a talk with Myra and Gene leads to a tearful apology. And, will a one-on-one with Dr. Phil’s wife, Robin, help Myra see that she deserves to be treated with dignity and respect? Will Myra set some standards in her broken marriage? Will there even be a marriage to speak of when they get home? Dr. Phil has some strong words for Gene. Next, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity pits brother against brother as Edwin and Eugene audition for a Hollywood talent agent and a casting director. Don’t miss the surprising twist when they get a call from the judges. Then, it’s time to switch gears – literally! Since Myra and Melissa never learned to drive, Dr. Phil sets them up with a driving lesson so they can become more independent. And you won’t believe the prize in store for the women if they pass their driver’s test! Dr. Phil sits down with the entire family one last time. Will they use the tools he gave them to build healthier relationships?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Recently, parents across America were googling “Who is Andrew Tate?” making him number three in Google searches for 2022, right behind Queen Elizabeth and Donald Trump. Tate claims to be helping young men acquire lots of money, drive luxury cars, and pick up hot women. However, in August 2022, Tate was banned on social media for his misogynist viewpoints. Twenty-four-year-old Ben says when he was a teen, he had zero self-esteem, never got past the first date, and felt powerless with girls. He tells Dr. Phil that men like Tate inspired him to break out of his shell -- and he shares how. Then, a healthy debate about “toxic masculinity” with the “Godfather of the Manosphere," a scholar and author, a men’s rights attorney, and the CEO and founder of the Center for Countering Digital Hate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Andrew Tate is known for his misogynistic social media posts and videos claiming to be helping young men acquire lots of money, drive luxury cars, and pick up hot women. Tate is fighting a legal battle in Romania right now, but should parents worry about his influence on their sons? Before Tate was detained, Dr. Phil spoke with Richard Reeves, senior fellow at the Brookings Institute and author “Of Boys and Men: Why the Modern Male is Struggling, Why it Matters, and What to Do about It”; Marilyn York, a men’s rights attorney; Imran Ahmed, CEO and founder of the Center for Countering Digital Hate; and blogger and author Rollo Tomassi. Plus, hear from a group of teenage boys who surprise their mothers when they share what they think about Tate. And, Robin joins the conversation.

programme.title: Dr. Phil Primetime
programme.desc: Dr. Phil joins NYC Mayor Eric Adams on an evening tour of Herald Square and West 4th Street subway stations to explore the PATH initiative, which offers resources to help homeless and mentally ill individuals transition off the streets.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Lauren says she resents her parents, Laura and John, claiming that as a teen, Laura stole her identity and racked up $50,000 in debt – a claim Laura denies – and that John had affairs on her mom and drank alcohol and used drugs with her and her teenage friends. John admits he was the “party dad,” but claims he was just trying to bond with Lauren. But is this just the tip of the iceberg? Dr. Phil drops the bombshell that John spent nearly two years behind bars and was dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news. It’s a Dr. Phil episode you cannot miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, amid claims of drinking and doing drugs with teenagers and extramarital affairs, Dr. Phil revealed that Lauren’s father, John, had been dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news, for stealing thousands of dollars’ worth of breast pumps and selling them online --and admitted to taking Lauren on some of his shoplifting heists. Today, John admits that he’s addicted to Xanax and crack cocaine, and to stealing from Lauren’s mother to support his habit. Lauren says she wants her mom to kick him out of their lives once and for all. How does Laura respond? It’s a shocking conclusion you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nicky, 17, says she loves to fight and proudly posts the videos of the brawls on the Internet. The teen brags that she once cracked a girl’s head on the concrete, has broken cheekbones and noses, and has had so many confrontations, she's lost count. She says the police have been called to her home as many as 80 times, and she’s been arrested monthly since she was 13 years old. What’s at the root of her rage? Dr. Phil delves deep into Nicky’s past to find the source of her pain. And, Nicky’s mom, Yvette, says she feels helpless and fears her daughter will end up dead or in prison, but is she modeling bad behavior? An anonymous letter to the show makes shocking allegations against Yvette. Can Dr. Phil get this family help -- before someone gets really hurt -- or worse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Levi and Bob say their once-perfect, honor roll student, Tiffani, has changed into someone they don’t know, and she is terrorizing the family. Levi says the 15-year-old is mean and evil, drinks, steals and fights with her every day. In one altercation, Levi says Tiffani spit in her face, punched her and threatened to push her off a balcony, and now she’s afraid for her life. Bob says Tiffani doesn’t respect discipline or any authority -- including the police. Tiffani has been in juvenile detention three times, and Bob says each time she's released, her behavior only escalates. Dr. Phil takes a look into their family dynamics. How might Bob and Levi be contributing to Tiffani's recklessness? Plus, hear from Tiffani. You may be surprised to hear why she says she acts out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: As the nation reels from the intense pressure of the 2020 Election, Dr. Phil welcomes broadcaster, journalist, and author Piers Morgan, whose latest book, Wake Up, is all about our divided society in the wake of COVID-19, the BLM protests, and the controversy surrounding the presidential election. Watch while Morgan reveals details of a 25-minute phone conversation he had with Donald Trump -- their first communication in months after he unfollowed Morgan on Twitter earlier this year. Dr. Phil and Morgan take a look at some of the most shocking stories of celebrities who have been "cancelled" in 2020, as well as some of the most tone-deaf mistakes made by the rich and famous. Also, how does Morgan keep his emotional and mental health in check during these trying times? Tune in to find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

programme.desc: Parents seek Dr. Phil's help for an out-of-control teen.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Rheta says her four-and-a-half-year marriage to Mark is headed down a rocky road, and her mother-in-law, Deb, is in the driver's seat. Rheta says it's time for Mark to cut the cord with the woman she calls deceitful, backstabbing, sneaky and controlling -- or else! Meanwhile, Deb says she hates Rheta, claiming she's violent, trashy and undeserving of her son. The tension between the women has escalated to blows on more than one occasion, leaving Mark literally in the middle. Where do his loyalties lie? Hear the drastic measures Deb has taken to get Rheta out of their lives. And, did Rheta reveal a secret in the hopes of ruining Deb's 31-year marriage? Is this a case of an overprotective mom overstepping her boundaries, or a wife's resentment getting the best of her? Dr. Phil mediates this war of words and helps to draw some lines in the sand. Whose side will Mark be on? Can this marriage and family be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his interview with Rachel, who accuses Walt of murdering her 14-year-old sister in 1985, despite his vehement denial. Walt claims Rachel might have been involved in her sister’s death -- an accusation she strongly denies. Both agree to take a polygraph test -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You hear about scams all the time - e-mails and voicemails claiming you have won valuable prizes. Dr. Phil is outraged by what some scammers are doing to him, his family and his viewers. One website offers a Dr. Phil quiz to win $5,000 every hour, another says it has the official Dr. Phil personality test, but even more shocking are 800 numbers that take callers' money for the promise of over the phone therapy with Dr. Phil and Robin. But these 800 numbers connect innocent victims with con artists posing as Dr. Phil staff members. The fake staffers ask anywhere from $375 to $1,000 for consultation time that obviously never takes place.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The drama continues as Dr. Phil goes on the hunt for con artists who cheat viewers out of thousands of dollars by posing as him and Robin.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The case of missing Stacy Peterson is discussed.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The children of Drew Peterson deal with the reality of their father's suspected involvement in their mother's murder and stepmother's disappearance.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When it comes to children and sports, many believe there is a huge problem with entitled athletes. Are athletes being coached to believe they are individually more important than their teams and that the rules simply don’t apply to them? Dr. Phil sits down with parents, athletes, coaches, and students who all say yes – but they strongly disagree about who is to blame. A coach claims parents are to blame due to modeling outrageous and entitled behavior. However, the sports parents in Dr. Phil’s audience push back, claiming coaches need to stop blaming them and start blaming themselves. Then, meet a referee who wrote an emotional email to parents informing them he was quitting due to their sideline behavior. And, a former all-American quarterback talks about the dark side of college sports. Plus, ESPN investigative reporter Paula Lavigne reveals some of what she has uncovered.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You’ve seen the headlines about student athletes being accused of sexual assaults and other egregious acts -- but are athletes being supported and protected by universities? Dr. Phil meets two women who claim they were sexually assaulted by college athletes and say there is a big double standard when it comes to athletes accused versus typical students. Bailey claims she was sexually assaulted by three basketball players but claims they were protected by the university. Then, Teresa says she knows firsthand the double standard when it comes to athletic preferential treatment because, even though the person who assaulted her was convicted, served time, and had to register as a sex offender, he was allowed to return to the field and was hailed as a star for another university. Plus, when an attorney claims athletes are the victims and their notoriety makes them easy targets for false accusations, he sparks an emotional debate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his exclusive jailhouse interview with Kelli Stapleton, a mother accused of trying to kill herself and her severely autistic 14-year-old daughter, Issy. Were there any warning signs that she was reaching her breaking point? And, find out how you can help Issy secure a healthy and productive future.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In September 2013, Kelli Stapleton and her 14-year-old daughter, Issy -- who suffers from severe autism -- were found in the family van, suffering from carbon monoxide poisoning. Could Kelli have done the unthinkable? In a Dr. Phil exclusive, the jailed Michigan mom opens up about what happened.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Doug and Debbie's once-perfect family has been shattered by the frightening reality that they could lose their 21-year-old son, Brandon, to drugs. Dr. Phil lays the groundwork for a successful intervention.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In a Dr. Phil exclusive, a 17-year-old football star accused of rape -- and the alleged victim -- speak out about how one alcohol-fueled night changed their lives in an instant. Matt says he and three friends were drinking at a party nearly nine months ago when the four boys had sex with a 16-year-old classmate. He claims she initiated the encounter and that the sex was consensual. Matt and the three boys are charged with second-degree rape, and Matt says his dreams of getting a college scholarship have been put on hold. How does he describe the events of that night? And, what, if anything, does he say he’d do differently? Then, hear from the alleged victim, who is speaking out for the first time. What does she recall happening that night? And, how has the ordeal impacted her life? Plus, Matt’s parents, Dianne and Mark, insist their son is innocent and say they believe the alleged victim is out for attention. Dr. Phil has a powerful message for the couple.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil delves into the dangers of teenage sex and underage drinking -- and how three families have been affected. In Part 2 of his exclusive interview, the 16-year-old girl who claims high school football star Matt and three other classmates raped her at a party opens up about what she says happened that night. Why does she say her peers care more about the accused football players than they do her? Don’t miss Matt and his parents’ reactions to what she has to say. Then, Leah alleges that in 2011, her 15-year-old daughter, Rehtaeh, was raped by four classmates at a party, and that after nearly a year-and-a-half of relentless bullying, the teen took her own life. How could this have been prevented? And what message does Leah have for others in similar situations? Plus, hear from Alexis, who says she too was raped at 15 and “could’ve been Rehtaeh.” What does she say got her through her darkest moments? Don’t miss this powerful cautionary tale for every teen and parent! This program contains strong sexual content.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In an exclusive interview, Gabby Petito’s parents speak out all together for the first time since the 22-year-old “Van Life” vlogger's body was discovered in Grand Teton National Park in Wyoming. As the manhunt for her fiancé, Brian Laundrie, continues, they share their knowledge about his survival skills, and talk about the heartbreaking moment her stepfather had to identify Gabby. They also honor her life and memory, and discuss what they hope will be her legacy.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part 2 of Dr. Phil’s exclusive interview with Gabby Petito’s parents, who are all sitting down together for the first time, they share where they believe Brian Laundrie may be hiding, and what they hope happens to him if he was involved in Gabby’s death. Plus, see their reaction to the latest developments in their daughter’s case.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Two women face the grandmother who they say did not protect them for the first time in 7 years.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Witness a classic ACC vs. Big 12 showdown at the Arch Pickleball Center as the Virginia Cavaliers and UCF Knights battle through a grueling series that pushes both teams to the brink. The Racing pace of the "firefights" at the net keeps spectators on edge as both sides trade rapid-fire volleys in a test of pure reaction time. Technical Skills are on full display with precision dinks and rare "Bert" shots that highlight the high-level strategy required for collegiate dominance. In a Freestyle display of grit and determination, the match culminates in a high-voltage sudden death round where every shot determines who will advance in the national bracket.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: The storied rivalry between the North Carolina Tar Heels and the NC State Wolfpack reaches a fever pitch on the pickleball court during the 2024 DUPR Virginia Beach Super Regional semi-finals. Watch as standout players like Ian Hunter—a 2023 national challenger bracket champion—and Faith Eichner battle against NC State's seasoned duo of Peter Glass and Lauren Hutchinson. With strategic roster shifts and high-stakes rallies, both teams fight for every point to secure regional dominance and avoid a winner-take-all Dream Breaker finale. Experience the intensity of this intrastate clash as North Carolina's premier collegiate talent vies for a spot in the championship match.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Experience the electrifying atmosphere at Mumbai’s Jio World Garden as the Mumbai Pickle Power hunt for their first tie victory of the season against the formidable Hyderabad Superstars. The tension reaches a fever pitch with Hyderabad’s "fireball" Shawn Mendes dominating the singles court, while Mumbai’s Brandon Lane and Santhosh Narayanan aim to turn the tide in the critical doubles matchups. Witness high-risk "Pickle Plays" and strategic substitutions as these athletes battle for precious points on the road to the semi-finals. With both teams fighting for survival on the league leaderboard, every rally is a masterclass in professional grit and tactical brilliance.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: Experience the electric atmosphere of the 2023 DUPR Collegiate National Championship as Florida State University faces off against the powerhouse University of North Carolina. The "intensity is off the charts" in this high-stakes encounter, where the "Racing" pace of rapid-fire volleys forces both teams to "battle it out" for every point as FSU fights for critical tournament seeding. Witness the incredible "Skills" of players like Caitlin and Jenna as they deliver clinical "perfect shots," while "Freestyle" creativity and grit are on full display in a match that could mark a major shift in the collegiate landscape.

programme.title: European Pickleball Championship
programme.desc: The 2025 European Pickleball Championships in Rome, Italy, hosts the high-stakes Women's Doubles Open Final featuring Team England against Team Spain. programme.title: Picklebowl 2022
programme.desc: Watch as Pickleball Pros Dan Granot and Phillip Phillips, paired with NFL legend Brandon Siler and Pickleball professional Ryan Sherry, battle it out in this thrilling Men's Doubles match from the Picklebowl 2022. Filmed in the stunning Sea Island, Georgia, this unique event brings together celebrities and professional athletes representing their alma maters. The game is not only about competition but also raising funds for a great cause, benefiting Desire Street Ministries. With star power from both the sports and entertainment worlds, this exciting match is filled with hard-hitting shots, strategic play, and thrilling moments that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: The atmosphere at the Arch Pickleball Center is electric as the Wisconsin Badgers face off against the UCSD Tritons on Championship Sunday. programme.desc: In this exciting episode, we venture out onto Porcupine Lake for some beautiful walleye action with Craig Salmonson from Timmins Angling Adventures. Patience was key as we waited for a break in challenging weather conditions—but it all paid off with an unforgettable day on the water. Tune in for expert tips, stunning scenery, and the thrill of fishing in Northern Ontario!

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Behind The Draw
programme.desc: On just 40 acres in Missouri, Mike has built one of the most consistent stand setups we’ve ever seen. He’s killed 3 mature bucks in 4 years from this ONE stand… and it’s not by accident. In this video, we break down exactly why this stand is so deadly—from access and wind to natural movement and terrain—and then take it a step further. We’re improving the setup with bedding thickets and hinge cutting to make it even harder for bucks to avoid. If you’re hunting a smaller property, this is a blueprint you can apply right now.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Learn to quilt step by step with National Quilting Circle experts on CraftsyTV.

programme.title: Fresh Quilting
programme.desc: Control is not the first word that comes to mind when thinking of modern quilting, but there are some techniques that can benefit by keeping things under control. Catherine Cureton illustrates the idea of controlled scrappy quilting. She has a new method for sorting fabrics that allows for stress free scrappy quilting. Then, Audrey Esarey has the guide for sewing curves. Keep stitching under control with some simple tips for curves. Then it's tips for walking foot quilting with Eliane Bergmann in the machine tip.

programme.title: T-Shirt Quilt for Father's Day
programme.desc: Angela raids her husband's closet to stitch up a special quilted Father's Day gift. This T-shirt quilt for Jeremy isn't just any old T-shirt quilt; it's a very cool design that uses big flying geese to frame the blocks.

programme.title: Bonus: Painter's Tape for Faster Quilting
programme.desc: As quilters, we make lots of HSTs (half-square triangles). If you like the two-at-a-time method, Angela has the hack for you! Watch as she uses painter's tape to sew quarter-inch seams instead of marking each square.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Angela's been practicing her magic tricks! Tonight, she amazes with a magnificent optical illusion quilt. Watch as she uses solid pre-cuts to magically create her star blocks.

programme.title: It's Sew Easy
programme.desc: Shapes, colors and designs by art masters can fuel your creative energy. Upcycling designer Michelle Paganini adds a touch of modern art to a refashioned shirt using three-ply reverse applique. Couture designer Angela Wolf creates her own embellished denim fabric with free-motion embroidery using a fabric frame.

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels
programme.desc: Artists see things differently. Our first featured bead type is pierced metal. Then artist Kate Richbourg creates Frida Kahlo inspired ear wires that feature the motifs in her paintings. Next artist Brenda Schweder encases found objects in a Joseph Cornell inspired piece that shows off his iconic style. Tammy Honaman ends the episode with the first of a series of projects highlighting artists' favorite materials. She begins with the art of the chenille stitch and how changing the color and finish changes the design.

programme.title: Scrapbook Soup
programme.desc: Titles start the story. Calligrapher Joanne Fink creates luscious lettering and Julie Fei-Fan Balzer shares her favorite title ideas. Christine Drumheller has a tip for making mini-albums and Ashley Horton lets loose with foils and colors to create attention- grabbing titles.

programme.title: Make It Artsy
programme.desc: Add art to every surface; inside and out. Host Julie Fei Fan Balzer demonstrates a marbling technique; you won't want to stop until every surface is marbled. programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Laufey’s: A Night at the Symphony - Hollywood Bowl
programme.desc: A cinematic concert film capturing Laufey’s spellbinding homecoming at the Hollywood Bowl, performed with the Los Angeles Philharmonic. Blending jazz-pop songwriting with lush orchestration, Laufey guides viewers through an evening of romance, nostalgia, and self-discovery—interwoven with behind-the-scenes moments, reflections on Los Angeles, and a special appearance from her twin sister, Junia.

programme.title: Don't Go Gentle: A Film About IDLES
programme.desc: Don’t Go Gentle chronicles the rise of British punk band IDLES, exploring how a group of friends from Bristol transformed pain and vulnerability into creative power. Through candid interviews, raw live performances, and emotional moments, the film captures the band’s journey from small clubs to international acclaim.

programme.title: Rascal Flatts: Life Is a Highway Tour: Live from Columbus
programme.desc: Country superstars Rascal Flatts celebrate 25 years of music with a hometown performance in Columbus, Ohio, recorded on their Life Is a Highway Tour. The set features timeless hits like Bless the Broken Road, What Hurts the Most, Mayberry, Fast Cars and Freedom, and Life Is a Highway. It’s an evening filled with nostalgia, gratitude, and classic country harmony.

programme.title: Chase Atlantic: Live from Hollywood
programme.desc: Chase Atlantic, an Australian trio based in LA, produce unique pop rock/R&B fusion. Their sound is identifiable through Mitchel Cave’s vocals and danceable tracks.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Grammy Award-winning singer-songwriter Joss Stone joins Joel Madden for a candid conversation about growing up in the music industry, her love of horror movies, and the process of creating a live album.

programme.title: Waterparks: FANDOM Live in the UK
programme.desc: A kinetic concert film captured at a sold-out O2 Academy Birmingham (Jan 2020), where Waterparks perform FANDOM through an alternate-universe lens. Executive producers Awsten Knight and Jawn Rocha fuse practical and special effects so every song looks the way it feels on stage—euphoric, chaotic, and intimate. Setlist highlights include crowd-igniting moments like “Dream Boy,” “High Definition,” “Dizzy,” and more, with circle pits, call-and-response, and fourth-wall breaks as the band records a live CD/DVD with the audience.

programme.title: The Specials: A Message To You
programme.desc: This episode of Record On explores how The Specials emerged from late-1970s Britain amid political unrest, racial tension, and economic struggle. Through rare footage and new interviews with Lynval Golding, Horace Panter, Pauline Black, Rhoda Dakar, and Damon Albarn, the film examines how the band’s fusion of ska and punk became an anthem for unity.

programme.title: Oasis: Live by the Sea
programme.desc: Oasis performs a 1995 concert in Southend, delivering early hits like Live Forever and Supersonic as they rise to international fame.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Simple Plan frontman Pierre Bouvier joins Joel Madden for an in-depth conversation on balancing family and touring life, creative longevity, and the band’s continued success. They revisit their early 2000s pop-punk roots, reflect on 20+ years of friendship, and discuss Simple Plan’s special edition book with Alternative Press as the band enters one of its strongest eras yet.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Chase Rice talks about his hit song, the challenges of festivals, and his experience at Stagecoach.

programme.title: Dropkick Murphys: St. Patrick’s Day 2024 Live from Boston
programme.desc: Dropkick Murphys return home to Boston for their annual St. Patrick’s Day concert at the MGM Music Hall at Fenway, performing fan favorites like “The Boys Are Back,” “The State of Massachusetts,” “Queen of Suffolk County,” and “Johnny, I Hardly Knew Ya.” With surprise guest Billy Bragg opening the show, plus appearances by Kneecap and Pennywise, the night captures the fierce pride, Celtic punk energy, and hometown spirit that define the band’s legacy.

programme.title: Jay Pharoah: Can I Be Me?
programme.desc: Jay Pharoah delivers a stand-up special packed with celebrity impressions and sharp humor, featuring takes on icons like Jay-Z, Barack Obama, and more.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden interviews Hongjoong of ATEEZ on life as a K-pop artist and Korea's global cultural influence.

programme.title: Cypress Hill: Live At The Royal Albert Hall
programme.desc: Cypress Hill performs with the London Symphony Orchestra at the Royal Albert Hall. Hits from Black Sunday and more.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Mikaela Hoover discusses art and life on Artist Friendly, sharing personal insights and her pride in her wife's company, House of Harlow.

programme.title: Artist Friendly

programme.title: Episodio 105
programme.desc: Fabián y Armando llegan a la casa de Finita los dos totalmente borrachos. Finita ni habla | solamente llora. Armando le llama señora Nevera. Ana sigue quejándose con Mauricio de la actitud de Olegario. Mauricio le da una charla del hombre machista latinoamericano. Olegario y Pastor están tomándose unos tragos y hablando de Ana. Ana le pide a Mauricio que se quede más tiempo con ella pero le dice que su mamá está enferma y que tiene mucho trabajo.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Toño desconfía de Nayarí, piensa que tiene algo con Gabriel León pero ella niega todo y termina contándole que Deibis es sobrino de Gabriel, o sea, este y el capitán hermanos. Gabriel le jura a Magdalena que él no tiene nada que ver con las fotos que le llegaron y si no fue un Paparazi desconfían de ambos esposos. Luego ella se siente muy culpable y deja bien en claro que no son amantes, es ahí cuando se larga a llover y León le dice que no ha dejado de pensar en ella. Mientras tanto Marilyn y Angie miran las mismas fotos y esta última se enoja mucho porque ve a su marido con otra mujer. Julieta habla con Valentina para que la ayude a hacer un reportaje a Gabriel León y esta acepta.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Benjamín revela que Carero intentó matarlo. Celia sufre una hemorragia y es trasladada de urgencia para una cesárea; Katiuska realiza rituales oscuros deseando su muerte. Marcelo y María del Pilar se reconcilian tras una fuerte discusión por Gustavo. Ricardo acude a la clínica desesperado por la salud de Celia, mientras Manuela se niega a revelarle la verdad. Alejandro decide enfrentar sus problemas en lugar de huir.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Erasto irrumpe en casa de Consuelo y exige llevarse a Natalia, pero ella se niega y él promete vengarse. Marisela exige a Adolfo evitar que Rosa tenga el niño. Alejandro le explica a Carmen Rosa lo del parentesco con Rosa y la convence de ayudar. Junior se compromete a casarse con Rosa pase lo que pase. Rosa decide casarse con Junior contra todos. Eustoquio sigue aterrorizando a Erasto disfrazado. Carmen Rosa duda en revelar el secreto. Consuelo decide ir a hablar con Rosa de nuevo, esta vez con calma. Isaías medita sobre la situación imposible.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Felipe puso en marcha el proceso de denuncia sobre la declaración de Alejandra, y junto a Carlos Ernesto intentan detener a Adolfo y a Rebeca antes de que sea demasiado tarde. Leo y María Lucía están dispuestos a luchar por su unión, hablan con Virginia y Trinidad y enfrentan a Julio después de enterarse de una mentira que le contó a Trinidad. Leonardo nuevamente intenta, en su última oportunidad antes de casarse, de demostrarle su amor a Irene para que ella lo acepte y así detener la boda. La policía detiene a Rodrigo e intenta llevarlo a la comisaría. En ese momento, la gente de Adolfo comienza a disparar para matar a Rodrigo y le dan un disparo. Tony compró un anillo de compromiso y se le declarará a Maribel.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cuando Guillermo y Ana decidieron no dejar a sus respectivas parejas, no luchar por su amor, no tenían idea de que les iba a resultar imposible. Así es como Ana levantada le pide a su madre un poco más de café, por desvelarse toda la noche pensando en Guillermo. Le cuenta a su madre, y ésta sólo le dice que tiene que olvidarse de Guillermo y seguir adelante con Cristóbal. A pesar de lo mal que se siente Ana, toma la decisión definitiva de olvidar a Guillermo, y ser feliz con Cristóbal. Éste por su parte pasa a buscar a Ana para llevarla al trabajo y regalarle flores. Ana le plantea la posibilidad de casarse cuanto antes. Cristóbal toma muy a gusto el planteo Ana, ya que la sentía dubitativa con respecto al casamiento.

programme.desc: Rene examina a Carmen Rosa y la hospitalizan una semana. Leticia insiste en que Vilma intentó matarla. Consuelo le oculta a Natalia que Erasto la visitó. Marisela y Andreína preparan maletas para Estados Unidos. Chencha llega a la residencia atormentada por su secreto. Erasto compra una quinta a nombre de Natalia mediante Rivera. Eustoquio enfrenta a Erasto amenazándolo de muerte. René revela accidentalmente a Consuelo que Arminda, la tía de Rosa, es la mujer que tenía secuestrada a Natalia. Consuelo grita como loca y cae desmayada al unir los cabos.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Consuelo se encierra en su cuarto recordando todos los maltratos que dio a Rosa sin saber que era su hija; confiesa a Leticia el descubrimiento. Junior defiende a Rosa de los insultos de Rosalía en la clínica. Alejandro confiesa a Adolfo que Rosa es su hija perdida, horrorizándolo al recordar que espera un hijo de Junior. Chencha confiesa a Blanca la verdad sobre Rosa. Erasto niega a Carmen Rosa toda culpa. Junior se desmaya al levantarse para ir al baño. Adolfo decide llamar a Consuelo para enfrentar la verdad con Rosa.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: José Luis y Natalia se reconcilian. Adolfo descubre por el médico que Junior sufrió parálisis motora y no podrá viajar. Rosa enfrenta a Consuelo en su casa y la expulsa, negándose a oírla y creéndola obsesionada con Isaías. Alejandro confiesa a Rosalía que Rosa es su hermana; ella jura odiarla siempre. Eustoquio se disfraza de Benedicto para enloquecer a Erasto. Adolfo y Marisela suspenden el viaje al exterior. Consuelo, abatida, llama a Adolfo desde el llanto para contarle que Rosa la odia a muerte y le concede toda la razón.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Eustoquio se viste de Benedicto burlándose de Erasto frente a Humberto. Consuelo le confiesa a Leticia su desesperación por el rechazo de Rosa. Carmen Rosa miente a Rosa diciendo que culpó la fiebre por la confesión; Rosa le cree. Adolfo cuenta a su familia el hallazgo de su hija. Rosalía exige pruebas y jura odiar a Rosa. Marisela cae en cuenta que el hijo de Rosa es de Junior, su propio hermano, y debe ser abortado. Erasto recibe la escritura de la quinta para Natalia y le pide a Arminda llamarla, mientras Arminda informa a Eustoquio para vengarse.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Erasto irrumpe en casa de Consuelo y exige llevarse a Natalia, pero ella se niega y él promete vengarse. Marisela exige a Adolfo evitar que Rosa tenga el niño. Alejandro le explica a Carmen Rosa lo del parentesco con Rosa y la convence de ayudar. Junior se compromete a casarse con Rosa pase lo que pase. Rosa decide casarse con Junior contra todos. Eustoquio sigue aterrorizando a Erasto disfrazado. Carmen Rosa duda en revelar el secreto. Consuelo decide ir a hablar con Rosa de nuevo, esta vez con calma. Isaías medita sobre la situación imposible.

programme.title: Episodio 101
programme.desc: Yubiri histérica y furiosa le como le comunica a los presentes que ha decidido renunciar | que se va de la Agencia. Briggite se muestra preocupada con la noticia mientras que cada uno se retrae en sus pensamientos. Yubiri le grita a Briggite una vez más su decisión de irse de la agencia. Entre tanto Wilker y su grupo de música ACAN de terminar la grabación de su disco; con un gran éxito; Los muchachos ríen y se disponen a celebrar | mientras Wilker internamente se regocija pensando en Yuribi.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Ana le dice a Pastor que no la bese ya que él es gay. Pastor le dice que no lo es | y que para conseguir el puesto con Mauricio tuvo que hacerse pasar por gay porque sino Mauricio no lo empleaba. En la casa de Gisela está Mauricio ya que son amigos de mucho tiempo. Ella trata de averiguar si es gay. El no cae en la trampa y llega Atanasio. Pastor ve la imagen de Olegario y el le dice a Ana que lo disculpe que no volverá a pasar aunque en verdad está enamorado de ella. A Ana le gustó Juan Diego.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Wilker va a la casa de Yubiri para llevarle el CD. Cuando llega Yubiri está totalmente fuera de sí por lo de Briggite y le forma tremendo escándalo botándolo de la casa. El le deja el CD. Daniel Alvarado llega a la oficina de Junior. Graciela está que se muere y Daniel Alvarado le dice a Junior que el guión necesita unos ajustes. Esto no le gusta para nada a Junior. Wilker está sumamente triste caminando por el centro comercial y Solymar lo ve y lo va a saludar. El le regala un CD.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Fabián le cuenta a Armando un poco de cosas echándoselas de machista. Pero le dice que ya está de nuevo viviendo con Finita. Finita le sigue contando a su amiga Rossy que mientras no se enteren ni Fabián ni Armando | ella es feliz. Mauricio está de nuevo contándole a Pastor que él tiene que fingir ante la gente pero en ese momento llega Atanasio. Pastor respira profundo. Ana le recrimina a Olegario que no la haya felicitado por su aumento.

programme.title: Episodio 105
programme.desc: Fabián y Armando llegan a la casa de Finita los dos totalmente borrachos. Finita ni habla | solamente llora. Armando le llama señora Nevera. Ana sigue quejándose con Mauricio de la actitud de Olegario. Mauricio le da una charla del hombre machista latinoamericano. Olegario y Pastor están tomándose unos tragos y hablando de Ana. Ana le pide a Mauricio que se quede más tiempo con ella pero le dice que su mamá está enferma y que tiene mucho trabajo.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Benjamín es encarcelado y liberado tras meses por Hortensia, quien ignora que Julio César ordenó matarlo. Celia descubre que tiene una enfermedad terminal y lo oculta, aceptando que Ricardo dé su apellido al bebé. Katiuska quema una carta clave y busca dañar al hijo de Celia con brujería. Marcelo solicita el divorcio a Graciela y Misael prepara una prueba de ADN para Glorita, mientras se revela la verdadera naturaleza de Katiuska.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Misael le pide matrimonio a Manuela tras probar su paternidad, mientras Ovidio hace lo mismo con Celia, quien enferma gravemente. Katiuska realiza un ritual de magia negra contra Celia y se compromete con Ricardo. Alejandro se prepara para cumplir la promesa de matar a Néstor. Hortensia descubre que Celia es la madre del hijo de Benjamín y se opone a que lleve su apellido. Finalmente, Celia, Manuela y Elizabeth juran mantener en secreto la inminente muerte de Celia.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia, gravemente enferma, busca el perdón de su hermana. Mientras tanto, Gustavo inaugura su piano bar, evento al que asiste María del Pilar a escondidas. Manuela y Celia descubren con impacto la fiesta de compromiso de Ricardo y Katiuska, lo que desata la furia de Celia. En medio de celebraciones con antifaces y romances nacientes entre Margot y Alejandro, la tragedia golpea cuando Carrero apuñala a Benjamín en su celda y Katiuska recurre a la brujería para retener a Ricardo.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia y Manuela interrumpen el compromiso de Ricardo y Katiuska, lo que termina en agresiones. Benjamín es herido en la cárcel por orden de Katiuska. Celia decide ocultar su enfermedad terminal a Ricardo, mientras que Elizabeth, al enterarse del nuevo compromiso de su padre, lo rechaza definitivamente. programme.title: Caballo de Acero
programme.desc: Santa y Toya son dos amigos que comparten la pasión por el ciclismo y deciden emprender una aventura juntos. Lucharán contra viento y marea para ayudar a Santa a convertirse en ciclista profesional. A lo largo de su viaje, descubren que el verdadero valor del ciclismo no reside en ganar carreras, sino en la amistad y la camaradería que surgen entre ellos mientras persiguen un sueño.

programme.title: Aqu¡ sobre la Tierra
programme.desc: Narra las vicisitudes de los migrantes nahuas de la region huasteca de Hidalgo que ahora viven en Guadalajara,

programme.title: LA SANGRE ILUMINADA
programme.desc: Seis personajes explican su existencia entrelazada. Cada cierto tiempo, por una matemAtica inexplicable, sus vidas cambian y ocupan el cuerpo de otro.

programme.title: EL LLAMADO DEL AGUA
programme.desc: La gente se esta organizando para generar conciencia sobre el uso del agua tras sufrir los incendios masivos que devastaron el bosque.

programme.title: Ros de Ceniza
programme.desc: Esteban pone fin a su vida al lanzarse desde un puente hacia una presa, lo que lo transporta a un universo onírico. Allí emprende un viaje de purgatorio en el que debe enfrentarse a sus inseguridades y a la condena de vivir bajo el mando de su padre, un jerarca despótico que gobierna a la familia.

programme.title: EL REINO DE DIOS
programme.desc: Neimar quiere sentir la presencia de Dios, si tan solo pudiera descubrir como. Mientras tanto, busca una felicidad que entra en conflicto con las complejidades de la vida real.

programme.desc: Cristina, de 43 años, atraviesa un embarazo de alto riesgo y vive una noche trágica al enterarse de que una explosión ha afectado el lugar donde se cree que se encuentra su hija adolescente, Amalia.

programme.desc: Emprendimos un recorrido en barco de 32 km que, en cada parada, nos permitió conectar con experiencias vitales en torno a diversas realidades socioambientales vinculadas al río Suquía.

programme.title: DIAS BORROSOS
programme.desc: Emilia, contemplando la maternidad en un mundo pospandemico, forma una conexion inesperada con su deprimido vecino anciano, Felipe.
